about: Autonomous UI exploration (ui.Offers, ui.Explore, ui.Defaults) mutants for PROPERTY-TESTING P5.

mutants.name: ux-offer-disabled-node
mutants.rule: OffersIn excludes disabled controls under disabled Fieldsets or disabled Semantic nodes (OffersArePlayable).

mutants.name: ux-settle-skipped
mutants.rule: Explore calls Settle(h) after playing each act before snapshotting state and stepping temporal properties (ExploreSettlesBeforeChecking).

mutants.name: ux-idle-end-reported-as-cut
mutants.rule: When no offers remain and nothing is pending, Explore closes temporal residuals with temporal.Idle rather than temporal.Cut (ExploreEndsIdleWhenExhausted).

mutants.name: ux-script-drops-typed-text
mutants.rule: Found.Script preserves the exact drawn Text of every played FillIn act so findings replay identically (FindingsReplay).

mutants.name: ux-swarm-can-leave-none
mutants.rule: Swarm subsetting never leaves zero offers when the screen has at least one actionable offer (SwarmNeverLeavesNone).

mutants.name: ux-covered-pairs-overcounted
mutants.rule: Covered (state, act) pairs are deduplicated so repeated transitions never overcount Clean.Covered (CoveredPairsNeverOvercount).
